# DeepSeek-V4-Flash LAYER 2 reference at five tokens -- the first CSA+LID layer.
#
# Same capture as the other fixtures:
#   llama-eval-callback -m DeepSeek-V4-Flash-UD-Q4_K_XL-00001-of-00005.gguf \
#     -p "The capital of France is" --no-repack -c 512 -t 12
#
# Format: name|op|shape|sum
#
# Compressed Sparse Attention with the lightning indexer -- the hardest of the
# three kinds, 273 rows against Raw's 121. Kept here so the build has its
# reference before it starts, not after.
#
# It carries TWO compressor states, not one: csa_state_* feeding attention, and
# lid_state_* feeding the indexer, each with its own kv/score/ape and its own
# persistent tensor (dsv4_csa_state_*_l2, dsv4_lid_state_*_l2).
#
# The indexer chain, which has no analogue anywhere else in Bigtea:
#   lid_q / lid_q_pe / lid_q_rot   the indexer's own rotated query
#   lid_k                          its keys
#   lid_weights -> lid_score_masked -> lid_top_k
#   csa_top_k_mask -> csa_lid_kq_mask    the mask attention finally uses
#   csa_raw_k + csa_comp_k -> csa_k_all  raw and compressed keys concatenated
#   attn_csa_lid                         the attention itself
#
# Unlike layer 3, this layer DOES run its compressors: csa_state_compress and
# lid_state_compress both appear, and lid_state_compress_rot applies a Hadamard
# rotation (llama_mul_mat_hadamard) that the Raw path never uses.
